chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said to Zurārah:
"The salat (prayer) is not to be repeated except for five things: taharah (purification), time, the qiblah, ruku' (bowing), and sujud (prostration)."

key_terms.الرُّكُوعِ: ruku' (bowing), an essential act of the prayer
key_terms.السُّجُودِ: sujud (prostration), an essential act of the prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer whose validity is being discussed
key_terms.الطَّهُورِ: taharah (ritual purification), a required state or condition for valid prayer
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of the qiblah that must be faced in prayer
key_terms.الْوَقْتِ: the prescribed prayer time, whose observance is essential

ai.seo_question: For which mistakes must salat (prayer) be repeated according to Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle regarding when salat (prayer) must be repeated. It limits the causes of repetition to five foundational matters: taharah, proper time, facing the qiblah, ruku', and sujud.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The prayer is not to be repeated except for five things: purification (taharah), time (observing the prayer time), facing the Qiblah, bowing (ruku'), and prostration (Sujood)”.
